meta.homeTitle: Kanjido — play first, learn deeper, remember longer
meta.homeDescription: Gamified kanji learning. Pick a single kanji and unlock every compound from JLPT N5 to N1.

home.streakComeBack: Play one lesson today to keep your streak.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to save your kanji learning progress.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong, please try again.
auth.tutorialReset: Tutorial will show again next time you play.

play.title: How to pick a lesson
play.lead: Each tile is a kanji theme. Master enough words to stamp it ✓.
play.s1: Pick any theme — start with one that feels familiar.
play.s2: Play at least one lesson a day to keep your 🔥 streak.
play.s3: Get 5 distinct words right in a theme to stamp the lesson.
play.tip: Tip: the streak chip in the header reminds you whether you've played today.

lesson.title: How to pick a kanji & level
lesson.lead: Each kanji has multiple JLPT levels N5 → N1. Start with the easiest.
lesson.s1: Tap a kanji to reveal levels N5 → N1.
lesson.s2: Tap a level that has words to start a round.
lesson.s3: Levels marked 'Coming soon' just have no words yet — check back later.
lesson.tip: Tip: start at N5 and climb up gradually — no need to jump to N1.

game.title: How a round works
game.lead: Answer before the timer runs out to earn stars.
game.s1: Pick Meaning or Reading — the timer only starts after you choose.
game.s2: Type your answer and submit. Many phrasings are accepted.
game.s4: Get 5 distinct words right in the theme to complete the lesson.
game.tip: Tip: in Reading mode you only need to type the reading of the blanked-out cell.

banner.title: First time here?
